description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 1785/17 of 19.11.2012, Homagama D/S Division
reasoning: This gazette exclusively deals with land title registration matters, specifically an amendment to a title registration for a specific parcel of land (No. 12 of Block 13) in Godagama. It involves updating land records with servitude rights and encumbrances, which falls squarely under Land Gazettes (Type 4) for land and property-related administrative matters. There is no government personnel or structural content that would trigger Types 1-3.
